newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian gold, silver trade shut for local holiday.
newsitem.headline: Indian gold, silver trade shut for local holiday.

text.p: Indian gold and silver markets were closed on Monday for a local religious holiday and will reopen on Tuesday, dealers said.
They said that on Friday, gold prices opened weak and continued to lose on the back of subdued sentiments in the world market and poor physical demand.

A gold biscuit (116.50 grammes) settled 250 rupees lower at 60,100 rupees. Silver prices fell on the back of a downtrend in the global market but limited supplies, shortage of ready stock and fresh industrial enquiries trimmed early losses towards the close.
